text.tspan: Network Architecture - Customer to APIM to Foundry to Anthropic
No VNet peering under any circumstances - Private Link or a public endpoint are the only two paths in

tenant is a billing/identity boundary, not a region)

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

text.tspan: App subnet
Customer Application (AI Force App) - holds
OPTION 1 (OAuth2 client credential) or
OPTION 2 (APIM subscription key)

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

text.tspan: Private endpoint subnet (optional - Private Link path only)
Private endpoint NIC targeting APIM's Private Link connection in the Provider Tenant

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(248, 206, 204), rgb(81, 45, 43)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(184, 84, 80), rgb(215, 129, 126));

text.tspan: HARD CONSTRAINT: no VNet peering with the Provider Tenant, under any
circumstances

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(108, 142, 191), rgb(92, 121, 163));

text.tspan: NSG restricts egress to only the gateway's private IP (or public FQDN) + Private DNS
zone (privatelink.azure-api.net) linked here for the private path

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 242, 204), rgb(40, 29, 0)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

text.tspan: Alternative path: no Private Endpoint - public APIM endpoint + IP allow-list + TLS 1.2+
(customer's egress IPs)

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

text.tspan: Azure API Management (v2 tier) Accepts
OPTION 1 (OAuth2 Bearer JWT, validate-jwt) or
OPTION 2 (Subscription key) at the front door

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 255, 255), rgb(18, 18, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

text.tspan: Private Link connection endpoint
Cross-tenant approval workflow - accepts the customer's connection request, NAT
applied, NO peering involved

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(213, 232, 212), rgb(31, 47, 30)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

Claude deployment - public network access disabled on Foundry

text.tspan: Legend
• Blue = Customer Tenant resources • Green = Provider Tenant resources • Orange = Anthropic-operated / third party • Red = hard constraint • Amber = alternative path or note to reconfirm
• Solid green arrow = Private Link (no peering, NAT applied, approval workflow) • Dashed amber arrow = alternative public-endpoint path
